senses.en: a relationship between people, things, or ideas
a link that allows devices or systems to work together
a further bus, train, or flight taken during a journey

ex.en: Our internet connection stopped working during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们的网络连接中断了。

ex.en: Researchers have found a strong connection between regular physical activity and improved mental health among young adults.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，经常进行体育活动与年轻成年人心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。

tip: 表示两者的联系用connection between A and B。

senses.en: doing a job, or functioning

ex.en: The working hours here are nine to five.
ex.zh: 这里的工作时间是九点到五点。

ex.en: Is the machine still working?
ex.zh: 机器还在运转吗？

tip: working 是“工作的/运转的”；working hours 工作时间。
scene: People working at desks in an open office.

senses.en: An empty space between things or within something.
A difference between people, groups, or situations.
A period when something stops or does not happen.

ex.en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 小猫从篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable education could narrow the gap between wealthy households and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 让更多人获得负担得起的教育，可以缩小富裕家庭与弱势社区之间的差距。

col: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口
tip: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

senses.en: A dry substance consisting of very small loose particles.
To put a layer of powder on something.

ex.en: Stir the cocoa powder into a little warm milk.
ex.zh: 把可可粉搅入少量温牛奶中。

ex.en: Some manufacturers turn surplus fruit into powder to extend its shelf life and reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 一些生产商将多余的水果制成果粉，以延长保质期并减少食物浪费。

tip: powder通常不可数；一勺粉用a spoonful of powder。

senses.en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended
fall or bend downwards loosely

ex.en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。

ex.en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
ex.zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。

col: hang on a wall｜挂在墙上
tip: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

senses.en: Someone whose work involves politics, especially an elected government member.

ex.en: A local politician visited our neighbourhood to discuss transport.
ex.zh: 一位当地政治人物来到我们社区讨论交通问题。

ex.en: Politicians should consult local communities before making decisions that could affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 政治人物在作出可能影响公共服务获取的决定前，应征求当地社区的意见。

col: a local politician｜地方政治人物
an elected politician｜民选政治人物
a senior politician｜资深政治人物
tip: politician指从政者，本身不一定含贬义。

senses.en: An open container with a handle, or the amount it holds.

ex.en: She filled a bucket with water to wash the windows.
ex.zh: 她装了一桶水，准备用来擦窗户。

ex.en: Collecting rainwater in a bucket can help households reduce the amount of drinking water used for gardening.
ex.zh: 用桶收集雨水可以帮助家庭减少园艺活动中的饮用水用量。

tip: 一桶水用a bucket of water，of后接所装物。

senses.en: Causing worry or mental strain

ex.en: Moving house was stressful, but our friends helped.
ex.zh: 搬家让人压力很大，但朋友们帮了忙。

ex.en: Long commutes can make working life more stressful and leave less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 长时间通勤会增加工作生活的压力，并减少与家人活动的时间。

col: a stressful situation｜令人紧张的处境
a stressful job｜压力大的工作
a stressful experience｜令人紧张的经历
tip: stressful形容压力来源；stressed形容人的感受。

senses.en: Show that something is true using evidence
Turn out to be a particular thing or quality

ex.en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。

ex.en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
ex.zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。

col: prove a point｜证明一个观点
prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

senses.en: to make something more attractive by adding beautiful things
to paint walls or cover them with wallpaper

ex.en: We decorated the balcony with colourful pots and tiny lights.
ex.zh: 我们用彩色花盆和小灯装饰了阳台。

ex.en: Allowing students to decorate shared learning spaces may increase their sense of ownership and responsibility.
ex.zh: 允许学生装饰公共学习空间，可能增强他们的主人翁意识和责任感。

tip: decorate A with B表示用B装饰A。

senses.en: A large sea fish, or its white flesh eaten as food.

ex.en: We baked the cod with lemon and fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 我们用柠檬和新鲜香草烤了鳕鱼。

ex.en: Strict fishing limits can help cod populations recover while protecting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
ex.zh: 严格的捕捞限额可以帮助鳕鱼种群恢复，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。

tip: 鱼的单复数均为cod；指鳕鱼肉时不可数。

senses.en: An organised journey made for exploration or a specific purpose.
A group of people travelling together to explore or investigate.

ex.en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们为进山探险打包了保暖衣物。

ex.en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
ex.zh: 一支前往极地的科学考察队收集了海冰变化的重要证据。

col: an expedition to Antarctica｜南极考察
tip: expedition多指有组织、有特定目的的远行。

senses.en: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing

ex.en: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
ex.zh: 这位发明家向我们展示了一盏太阳能灯。

ex.en: Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
ex.zh: 发明者往往需要资金支持，才能把有前景的想法转化为造福社会的实用技术。

col: a brilliant inventor｜杰出的发明家
an aspiring inventor｜有志成为发明家的人
tip: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。

senses.en: Go somewhere with someone.
Exist or happen together with something else.
Play music to support a singer or another musician.

ex.en: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天姐姐会陪我去诊所。

ex.en: Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 城市扩张应配合公共交通投资，以防止交通拥堵并改善就业可达性。

col: accompany on the piano｜用钢琴伴奏
tip: 直接接人作宾语，不说accompany with someone。

senses.en: a competition to decide the best player or team
the position or title of being a champion

ex.en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
ex.zh: 我们校队打进了锦标赛的决赛。

ex.en: Hosting an international championship can attract visitors, but the cost of new facilities may burden local taxpayers.
ex.zh: 举办国际锦标赛可以吸引游客，但新建设施的费用可能加重当地纳税人的负担。

tip: 既可指争夺冠军的赛事，也可指冠军头衔。

senses.en: a particular time when something happens
an important or special event
a suitable opportunity to do something

ex.en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
ex.zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。

ex.en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
ex.zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。

col: rise to the occasion｜成功应对挑战
tip: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。

senses.en: A period or distance between events or objects.
A short break between parts of a performance.

ex.en: There was a short interval between the two calls.
ex.zh: 两通电话之间隔了一小会儿。

ex.en: Taking breaks at regular intervals can help students maintain concentration during long periods of study.
ex.zh: 长时间学习时，定时休息有助于学生保持专注。

col: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间或距离
during the interval｜在幕间休息时
tip: at intervals表示每隔一段时间或距离。

senses.en: a choice made after considering different possibilities

ex.en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
ex.zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。

ex.en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
ex.zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。

col: informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定
tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.en: a relationship between people who like and support each other

ex.en: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
ex.zh: 我们的友谊始于上学时做同桌的日子。

ex.en: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
ex.zh: 亲密的友谊可以在压力时期提供情感支持，从而改善心理健康。

col: a bond of friendship｜友谊的纽带
tip: 泛指友谊不可数；具体一段友谊可数。

senses.en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.

ex.en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。

col: efficient use of resources｜高效利用资源
tip: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

senses.en: warmth or a high temperature
to make or become warmer
a race that decides who enters the next round

ex.en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
ex.zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。

ex.en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。

tip: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

senses.en: the way someone or something looks
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
ex.zh: 重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: Images or designs used on screens or in printed materials.

ex.en: The game's colourful graphics looked amazing on our new screen.
ex.zh: 这款游戏色彩鲜艳的画面在我们的新屏幕上看起来棒极了。

ex.en: Clear graphics can make complex scientific information easier to understand for audiences without specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 清晰的图示能让没有专业知识的受众更容易理解复杂的科学信息。

tip: 指多个图像时用复数谓语：the graphics are。

senses.en: In a way that has no faults or mistakes.
Completely; used to emphasize a description.

ex.en: The new curtains match our sofa perfectly.
ex.zh: 新窗帘和我们的沙发非常相配。

ex.en: It is perfectly reasonable for residents to expect reliable public services in return for their taxes.
ex.zh: 居民纳税后期望获得可靠的公共服务，是完全合理的。

tip: perfectly clear意为十分清楚，不译作完美地清楚。

senses.en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel.
To lead a team or command a ship.
An officer holding a particular rank in the armed forces.

ex.en: Our captain gathered the team before the final match.
ex.zh: 决赛前，我们的队长把全队召集到一起。

ex.en: A team captain can encourage cooperation by ensuring that every player feels valued and included.
ex.zh: 队长可以通过确保每位队员都感到受到重视和接纳来促进合作。

col: captain a team｜率领一支队伍
tip: 军衔含义随军种变化；海军中通常指上校。

senses.en: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose or situation.
Real or satisfactory, rather than incomplete or inadequate.
Strictly understood, excluding surrounding or related things.

ex.en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
ex.zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合适的鞋。

ex.en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
ex.zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的机器前，应接受适当培训。

col: a proper meal｜一顿像样的饭
tip: 表示“本身的”时放名词后，如the city proper。

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

ex.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
ex.zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。

ex.en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
ex.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。

col: fear for someone's safety｜担心某人的安全
tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

senses.en: To like or choose something more than another option.

ex.en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。

ex.en: Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
ex.zh: 一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。

col: prefer A to B｜比起B更喜欢A
tip: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

senses.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
ex.zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

ex.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
ex.zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。

col: as cool as a cucumber｜非常镇定
tip: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。

senses.en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time.
Employed without a fixed end date.

ex.en: The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
ex.zh: 滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。

ex.en: Investment in flood prevention can reduce the risk of permanent damage to homes and public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。

tip: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。

senses.en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win
to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result
to compete for a position, prize, or political seat

ex.en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
ex.zh: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。

ex.en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
ex.zh: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。

col: a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛
contest a decision｜对决定提出异议
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged
to explain or represent something using a simple drawing

ex.en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
ex.zh: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。

ex.en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
ex.zh: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。

col: a labelled diagram｜带标注的示意图
tip: 侧重结构或原理的图解，不等同于数据图表。

senses.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.

ex.en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
ex.zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。

ex.en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。

col: the beauty of something｜某事物的妙处
tip: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。

senses.en: to draw a line through something written

ex.en: Cross out the wrong answers on the list.
ex.zh: 把清单上错误的答案划掉。

ex.en: She crossed out a sentence and rewrote it.
ex.zh: 她划掉了一个句子重写。

tip: cross out 表示“用线划掉”。
scene: A hand crossing out a word with a pen on a paper.

senses.en: located a short distance away
at or to a place a short distance away

ex.en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的一家面包店买了新鲜面包。

ex.en: Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.
ex.zh: 附近有方便前往的公园，能鼓励城市居民经常锻炼，并增加户外活动时间。

tip: nearby不用作介词：说near the school，不说nearby the school。

senses.en: An old object valued for its age, beauty, or rarity
Old and valuable because of age, beauty, or rarity

ex.en: We found a beautiful antique in a small shop.
ex.zh: 我们在一家小店里发现了一件漂亮的古董。

ex.en: Preserving antique furniture helps future generations understand traditional craftsmanship and the everyday lives of people in the past.
ex.zh: 保存古董家具有助于后代理解传统工艺以及过去人们的日常生活。

tip: antique强调古老且有收藏价值，不只是旧。

senses.en: a strap that keeps you safe in a car

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we drive.
ex.zh: 开车前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Everyone in the car must wear a seat belt.
ex.zh: 车里每个人都要系安全带。

col: fasten your seat belt｜系安全带
tip: fasten/put on your seat belt 是“系安全带”。
scene: A hand fastening a seat belt in a car.

senses.en: extremely impressive to see or experience
unusually great or impressive in degree

ex.en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the hilltop.
ex.zh: 我们在山顶看了一场壮观的日落。

ex.en: The region's spectacular mountain scenery attracts tourists, creating jobs but also increasing pressure on fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 该地区壮观的山景吸引着游客，创造了就业机会，但也加重了脆弱生态系统的压力。

tip: 既可形容壮观景象，也可修饰growth等抽象名词。

senses.en: Pay someone to work for you.
Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.

ex.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

ex.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

col: employ someone as｜雇用某人担任
tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

senses.en: the way someone feels at a particular time
the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates

ex.en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
ex.zh: 散一小会儿步通常就能让我的心情好一些。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
ex.zh: 能够享用绿地可以改善居民心情，促进城市社区内更积极的互动。

col: in the mood for｜有心情做……
tip: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。

senses.en: The ability to see.
The act of seeing or the area that can be seen.
Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.

ex.en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
ex.zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。

ex.en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
ex.zh: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。

tip: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

senses.en: finally, after everything

ex.en: In the end, we decided to stay home.
ex.zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。

ex.en: Everything worked out well in the end.
ex.zh: 最后一切都很顺利。

tip: in the end 表示“最终结果”；at the end 是“在…的末尾”。
scene: A family relaxing at home after deciding to stay in.

senses.en: a person who writes a blog

ex.en: She is a food blogger who posts recipes online.
ex.zh: 她是一位在网上分享食谱的美食博主。

ex.en: The blogger wrote about her trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 博主写了她的日本之旅。

tip: blogger 是写博客的人；blog 是博客。
scene: A young woman typing on a laptop at a café table with a camera.

senses.en: to put equipment or software in place for use
to formally place someone in an important position

ex.en: We hired an electrician to install the new ceiling fan.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位电工来安装新吊扇。

ex.en: Schools need sufficient funding to install reliable internet connections and maintain essential digital equipment.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来安装可靠的网络连接，并维护必要的数字设备。

col: install solar panels｜安装太阳能板
tip: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。

senses.en: cooked food bought to eat at home

ex.en: We ordered a takeaway for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们点了外卖当晚餐。

ex.en: The takeaway round the corner sells pizza.
ex.zh: 拐角的外卖店卖披萨。

tip: takeaway 是英式“外卖”；美式说 take-out。
scene: A takeaway box with pizza being carried out of a shop.

senses.en: Happening or existing at the beginning
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
ex.zh: 看到价格后，我最初的兴奋消退了。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.

ex.en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
ex.zh: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。

ex.en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
ex.zh: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。

tip: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

senses.en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment.
Willingly and without objection.
With a fortunate or pleasing result.

ex.en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
ex.zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。

ex.en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。

tip: 句首Happily可表“幸好”，不只表示开心。

senses.en: Feeling worried and unable to relax
Pronounced with greater emphasis than surrounding sounds
Experiencing physical force that may cause strain or damage

ex.en: I felt stressed before my first driving lesson.
ex.zh: 第一次上驾驶课之前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel stressed during examinations may benefit from regular exercise and adequate sleep.
ex.zh: 在考试期间感到焦虑的学生，可能会从规律运动和充足睡眠中受益。

col: highly stressed components｜承受高应力的部件
tip: 也可作stress的过去式或过去分词，表示“强调”。

senses.en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy

ex.en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。

ex.en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

tip: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

senses.en: to enter a place or vehicle

ex.en: Get in the car; we are leaving now.
ex.zh: 上车吧，我们现在就走。

ex.en: The train gets in at ten.
ex.zh: 火车十点到达。

tip: get in 表示“进入/上车”；车到达也说 get in。
scene: A person getting into a car through the open door.

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
ex.zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。

ex.en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

col: promise to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

senses.en: several related things or events following one another
a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject

ex.en: A series of small delays made us miss lunch.
ex.zh: 接连几次小耽搁让我们错过了午饭。

ex.en: The university introduced a series of workshops to help students evaluate information found on social media.
ex.zh: 这所大学推出了一系列研讨课，帮助学生评估社交媒体上的信息。

col: a series of events｜一连串事件
a television series｜电视系列节目
tip: 单复数同形：a series；two series。

senses.en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation
greater or more noticeable than usual
having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy

ex.en: Are you looking for any particular book today?
ex.zh: 你今天是在找某一本特定的书吗？

ex.en: Schools should pay particular attention to students who lack access to digital resources at home.
ex.zh: 学校应特别关注那些在家中无法获得数字资源的学生。

col: a particular reason｜某个特定原因
tip: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。

senses.en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them
to search carefully for someone or something
an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals

ex.en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。

ex.en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
ex.zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。

col: hunt wild animals｜猎捕野生动物
tip: 猎捕动物可直接接宾语；寻找物品常用hunt for。

senses.en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.
An organisation responsible for a particular area of work.
The ability to make choices and act independently.

ex.en: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
ex.zh: 旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店。

ex.en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
ex.zh: 国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。

col: individual agency｜个人自主行动能力
tip: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。

senses.en: Pay no attention to someone or something

ex.en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
ex.zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。

ex.en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
ex.zh: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。

tip: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。

senses.en: often or at repeated intervals
with equal spaces or a consistent pattern

ex.en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。

tip: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。

senses.en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away.

ex.en: The babysitter read a story while the children ate.
ex.zh: 孩子们吃东西时，临时保姆给他们读了一个故事。

ex.en: Finding a reliable babysitter can help parents balance occasional evening commitments with their childcare responsibilities.
ex.zh: 找到可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间事务和照顾孩子的责任。

col: hire a babysitter｜雇用临时保姆
find a babysitter｜找人临时照看孩子
tip: 通常指临时照看孩子的人，不只照顾婴儿。

senses.en: Needing immediate attention or action

ex.en: The plumber came quickly because the leak was urgent.
ex.zh: 漏水急需处理，所以水管工很快就赶来了。

ex.en: There is an urgent need for affordable housing as urban populations continue to grow.
ex.zh: 随着城市人口持续增长，人们迫切需要负担得起的住房。

col: urgent medical attention｜紧急医疗救治
tip: urgent强调必须立即处理，不仅是重要。

senses.en: light and warmth coming from the sun

senses.zh: 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
senses.en: happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness

ex.en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。

ex.en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

col: a ray of sunshine｜带来快乐的人或事
tip: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

senses.en: to close or attach something securely

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we leave.
ex.zh: 出发前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts during takeoff and landing to reduce the risk of injury.
ex.zh: 乘客在飞机起飞和降落时必须系好安全带，以降低受伤风险。

col: fasten a seat belt｜系好安全带
tip: t不发音；反义词unfasten表示解开。

senses.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.
A character played by an actor in a performance.

ex.en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
ex.zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。

ex.en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责
tip: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

senses.en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage.
To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly.
A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.

ex.en: My cousin cheated by hiding cards under the table.
ex.zh: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。

ex.en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
ex.zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。

col: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊
cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。

senses.en: The act of leaving a place.
A change from what is usual or expected.

ex.en: We packed our bags the night before departure.
ex.zh: 我们在出发前一晚收拾好了行李。

ex.en: The new housing policy represents a significant departure from previous approaches to urban development.
ex.zh: 这项新的住房政策与以往的城市发展思路有了显著不同。

col: a departure from tradition｜对传统的突破
tip: departure from可指“从……出发”或“背离……”。

senses.en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access
People or activities responsible for protecting a place
Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support

ex.en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
ex.zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。

ex.en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
ex.zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。

tip: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

senses.en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
ex.zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict
an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict
to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding

ex.en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
ex.zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。

ex.en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
ex.zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。

tip: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

ex.en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
ex.zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
ex.zh: 及早获得医疗服务可以防止小病发展为严重的健康问题。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
tip: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

senses.en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
an illness or physical problem

ex.en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
ex.zh: 她投诉汤是凉的。

ex.en: Local authorities should investigate residents' complaints about noise before approving new entertainment venues in residential areas.
ex.zh: 地方政府在批准住宅区内的新娱乐场所前，应调查居民关于噪声的投诉。

col: a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。

senses.en: to cut something into small pieces

ex.en: Cut up the vegetables before cooking.
ex.zh: 烹饪前把蔬菜切碎。

ex.en: She cut up the paper into small squares.
ex.zh: 她把纸剪成小方块。

tip: cut up 是“切碎/剪碎”。
scene: Hands chopping vegetables on a cutting board in a kitchen.

senses.en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something
Search carefully for hidden information
An organized activity to uncover ancient objects in the ground

ex.en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
ex.zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。

ex.en: Researchers dig into historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of rapid environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。

senses.en: the process of making or growing things for use
the making of a film or play, or the resulting work

ex.en: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
ex.zh: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。

ex.en: Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
ex.zh: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。

tip: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

senses.en: where something is or how a body is arranged
a job, social rank, or opinion on an issue
to put someone or something in a particular place

ex.en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
ex.zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？

ex.en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
ex.zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。

col: apply for a position｜申请职位
take a position on｜对……表明立场
tip: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

senses.en: To become visible or come into view.
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
ex.zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: not in or to any place

ex.en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
ex.zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。

ex.en: Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏可负担的住房，一些低收入家庭即使有固定工作，也无处居住。

col: in the middle of nowhere｜在偏僻之地
tip: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

senses.en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done.
An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.

ex.en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
ex.zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。

ex.en: Researchers analyse patterns of energy consumption to identify opportunities for reducing waste in households.
ex.zh: 研究人员分析能源消耗模式，以寻找减少家庭能源浪费的机会。

col: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式
follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

senses.en: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire.
Equipment for cooking food over a fire outdoors.
To cook food on a grill over a fire.

ex.en: We invited our neighbours to a barbecue in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们邀请邻居来花园参加烧烤聚餐。

ex.en: Designated barbecue areas allow visitors to cook outdoors while reducing the risk of fires in public parks.
ex.zh: 指定烧烤区既能让游客在户外烹饪，也能降低公园发生火灾的风险。

col: have a barbecue｜举办烧烤聚餐
tip: 既指烧烤聚餐或烤架，也可作动词；常缩写为BBQ。

senses.en: A substance that flows and takes the shape of its container.
In a form that flows freely rather than remaining solid.
Available as cash or easily converted into cash.

ex.en: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
ex.zh: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。

ex.en: Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
ex.zh: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。

tip: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

senses.en: the amount of snow that falls

ex.en: The city had heavy snowfall last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚这座城市下了大雪。

ex.en: Snowfall in the mountains makes skiing possible.
ex.zh: 山里的降雪使滑雪成为可能。

tip: snowfall 是“降雪/降雪量”。
scene: Snow falling heavily over a small town at night.

senses.en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern
to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes
to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly

ex.en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
ex.zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。

ex.en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
ex.zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。

tip: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。

senses.en: finally, after a long time

ex.en: At last, the bus arrived!
ex.zh: 公交车终于来了！

ex.en: We finished the project at last.
ex.zh: 我们终于完成了这个项目。

tip: at last 强调“经过等待终于发生”，比 finally 更有感情色彩。
scene: People at a bus stop cheering as the bus finally arrives.

senses.en: Moving to a position on a surface.

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
ex.zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。

ex.en: Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.
ex.zh: 将货物转移到火车上运输，可以缓解道路拥堵并降低运输业的排放。

col: load goods onto｜把货物装到……上
tip: onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。

senses.en: someone who prepares and sells meat
to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat
to do something very badly, spoiling the result

ex.en: The butcher wrapped our chicken and suggested a simple recipe.
ex.zh: 肉贩把我们的鸡肉包好，还推荐了一个简单的做法。

ex.en: A local butcher can help customers reduce food waste by recommending suitable cuts and portion sizes.
ex.zh: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。

col: butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。

senses.en: A date marking another year since an important event.

ex.en: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。

ex.en: The museum celebrated its anniversary by offering free admission to encourage more residents to explore local history.
ex.zh: 博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。

col: celebrate an anniversary｜庆祝周年纪念日
tip: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。

senses.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates
To move or travel very fast
To drive faster than the legal limit

ex.en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
ex.zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。

ex.en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
ex.zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。

tip: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

senses.en: a warm soft shirt with long sleeves

ex.en: He wears a blue sweatshirt to school.
ex.zh: 他穿蓝色卫衣上学。

ex.en: This sweatshirt is warm and comfortable.
ex.zh: 这件卫衣又暖和又舒服。

tip: sweatshirt 是运动卫衣；hoodie 是连帽卫衣。
scene: A blue sweatshirt folded on a bed.

senses.en: A formal event marking an important occasion.
Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.

ex.en: We attended a small wedding ceremony by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们参加了湖边一场小型婚礼。

ex.en: A graduation ceremony allows students and families to celebrate educational achievements together as a community.
ex.zh: 毕业典礼让学生和家人齐聚一堂，共同庆祝学业成就。

tip: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

senses.en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow
an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy

ex.en: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
ex.zh: 他用一杯水把药片吞了下去。

ex.en: Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.
ex.zh: 虽然药物可能缓解症状，但要持久改善健康，往往需要改变日常习惯。

tip: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。

senses.en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional.
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
ex.zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: A person who manages library resources and helps library users.

ex.en: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
ex.zh: 图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。

ex.en: School librarians support independent learning by teaching students how to locate reliable sources and evaluate information.
ex.zh: 学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。

col: ask a librarian｜咨询图书馆员
tip: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。

senses.en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight.
To prevent others from knowing or noticing something.
The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.

ex.en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
ex.zh: 我们把生日礼物藏在了床底下。

ex.en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
ex.zh: 企业不应隐瞒其产品或生产流程所涉及的环境风险信息。

col: hide from view｜藏起来不让看见
tip: 过去式hid，过去分词hidden；hide from意为躲避。

senses.en: not sleeping
to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

ex.en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
ex.zh: 雨终于停下时，我还醒着。

ex.en: Students who stay awake late at night may struggle to concentrate during lessons the following morning.
ex.zh: 熬夜不睡的学生第二天上午上课时可能难以集中注意力。

tip: 形容词通常作表语；动词变化为awoke、awoken。

senses.en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes.
To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance.
To push a pointed object into something.

ex.en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
ex.zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。

ex.en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。

col: stick to a plan｜坚持计划
stick a picture on｜把图片贴在……上
tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

senses.en: To remove written material or stored information.

ex.en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
ex.zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。

ex.en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
ex.zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。

tip: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

senses.en: In addition to someone or something.
Used to add another fact or supporting reason.

ex.en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
ex.zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。

ex.en: Besides reducing air pollution, investment in public transport can make cities more accessible to older residents.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。

col: besides the fact that｜除了……这一事实之外
tip: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。

senses.en: A roadside post showing directions to different places.
Mark a route or place with signs showing directions.
Make the structure or direction of an explanation clear.

ex.en: We stopped at the signpost beside the forest path.
ex.zh: 我们在林间小路旁的路标处停了下来。

ex.en: Writers should signpost changes in their argument so that readers can follow complex discussions more easily.
ex.zh: 作者应提示论证中的转折，让读者更容易跟上复杂的讨论。

col: signpost an argument｜提示论证脉络
tip: 写作中作动词，指用衔接表达提示论证结构。

senses.en: to register at an airport or hotel

ex.en: We need to check in two hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 我们需要在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。

ex.en: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive.
ex.zh: 到达后请到前台办理入住。

tip: check in 是动词短语；check-in 是名词“值机/入住手续”。
scene: A family checking in at an airport counter with luggage.

senses.en: a device that moves liquid or gas
to move liquid or gas using a pump

ex.en: I keep a bicycle pump beside the garage door.
ex.zh: 我把自行车打气筒放在车库门旁边。

ex.en: Solar power can operate a water pump, helping rural communities obtain clean water without relying on expensive fuel.
ex.zh: 太阳能可以驱动水泵，帮助农村社区获取清洁用水，而无需依赖昂贵的燃料。

col: pump up a tyre｜给轮胎打气
tip: pump up a tyre表示给轮胎打气；抽水用pump water。
